businesses.business: skilled nursing and senior living operator

offering_description.value: Owns and operates skilled nursing facilities, senior living communities and related healthcare businesses. Provides short-term rehabilitation, long-term nursing care and assisted living to seniors and patients. Also owns real estate leased to operators.

primary_services.value: skilled nursing care; rehabilitation therapy; assisted and independent living; home health and hospice; urgent care

customer_segment.value: B2C: seniors and patients receiving nursing, rehabilitation and assisted living care; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs paying for resident care; B2B: managed care and private insurers, third-party operators leasing real estate

end_markets.value: senior care; post-acute healthcare; senior living; healthcare real estate

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare, Medicaid and managed care payments for skilled nursing and rehabilitation care; service fees: private-pay residents in assisted living, home health and hospice; rental or leasing: rent from leased real estate to third-party operators
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs skilled nursing and senior living facilities serving residents and patients; service provider: delivers rehabilitation, home health and hospice services to patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Facilities in about a dozen-plus states, mainly western, southern and midwestern US, including California, Texas, Arizona and Utah

specialization.value: related lines: skilled nursing, senior living, home health, hospice and healthcare real estate

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned and operated nursing and senior living facilities; other: referrals from hospitals and physicians

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Facilities need state licenses and CMS certification, Medicare and Medicaid rules, state health departments and OIG oversight
